comment: Index order is not panel order in the gate row: the freeze gate is input 11 but is the leftmost jack of that row, with bend, break and corrupt to its right as inputs 8, 9 and 10. The three menu sliders (Glitch windowing, Stereo width, LED brightness) are ui::Slider widgets rather than params, so they cannot be clicked on the panel. The knob's damage and CV channels are stored per channel and swapped by the square buttons, so one param index covers three different settings depending on which channel is selected. configBypass wires the left and right inputs straight to the matching outputs.
